text:
Lina Chen: Quick experiment idea — micro-inbox nudge for brand-new signups to drive a first-success moment. Give a tiny credit (50 tokens) + a 3-prompt starter pack inline. Hypothesis: credit + curated prompt set → higher first-run completion (aiming ~+25% rel). Want to A/B test two micro-copy variants and template packs. Also need tracking plan and a short benchmark narrative for a small launch post. Thoughts?

Ravi Patel: Love it. Two variants I'd run: A) "Playground-first" (credit + pick-a-prompt) B) "Guided-walkthrough" (2-step mini tutorial using one curated prompt). Track funnel: signup -> microinbox_shown -> prompt_clicked -> prompt_run -> first_success. Event names: microinbox_shown, prompt_clicked, prompt_run, run_success. We should also capture variant and cohort. For social bench copy keep it conservative — "early pilots saw notable lift" not absolute numbers.

Maya Torres: I'll draft the micro-inbox copy. Variant A short: "Your first 50 tokens + 3 starter prompts — try one now" Variant B short: "Try our 2-step guided prompt and see results instantly" UX: show template with tiny example output and a CTA button. I'll wire minimal visuals.

Samir K: Cohort gating: only new users with 0 runs in first 24h. Exclude invited/internal/test accounts and upgrading users. Run for 7 days for initial signal. Quick power check — baseline first-run rate ~12% (internal); target uplift = +3 percentage points absolute (25% rel). Need sample size ~1.6k users per variant for ~80% power (very rough).

growth-bot: Suggested tracking snippet for implementation: ```js
// fire on render and on prompt click/run
analytics.track('microinbox_shown', {experiment: 'microsprint_3765', variant: 'A', cohort: 'new_signup'});
analytics.track('prompt_clicked', {prompt_id: 'starter_01', variant: 'A'});
analytics.track('prompt_run', {prompt_id: 'starter_01', success: true});
```

Lina Chen: Nice. For the bench narrative we can say: "In early pilot tests, a combined small credit + curated starter prompts noticeably increased first-run completion and time-to-first-value." Keep numbers internal-only. For the social launch (X/LinkedIn) we can include a tiny screenshot of the micro-inbox and call out the prompt templates.

Ravi Patel: Can Eng/Analytics set up a dashboard: metric = % users with run_success within 24h, broken down by variant + by device (web vs mobile). Routing: show micro-inbox in-app on first session; if not clicked within 24h send a single email fallback. Also add experiment id and UTM on social link.

Maya Torres: Draft copy (short): "New here? Get 50 tokens + 3 starter prompts to get going — try one now." CTA: "Run a prompt" Example prompts I'll include: "Summarize my doc", "Rewrite for a friendlier tone", "Generate interview questions". Saving drafts to #marketing-docs in ~30m. :memo:

Samir K: Quick ops note — make sure we tag excluded cohorts and log experiment_id=microsprint2026 in events. Also add a TTL for credits so they don't stack (expire in 14 days).

Lina Chen: Owners: Maya = copy + prompt pack, Ravi = tracking events + dashboard, Samir = cohort gating + sample size, I'll coordinate rollout and the small social launch. Target launch = next Tuesday (7 days). :rocket:

Ravi Patel: ACK. I'll add event defs to analytics repo and ping eng for the gating flag.

Maya Torres: :thumbsup: Posting drafts to #marketing-docs in 25.

Samir K: We'll need a short post-launch checklist: monitor spike in support tickets, confirm credit redemption rates, validate no duplicate grants. I'll add to the runbook.

Lina Chen: Perfect — thanks all. Will follow up with a one-pager (tracking table + copy variants) by EOD. :eyes:
